tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus bzhugs

so// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pos/ dur khrod la sogs pa rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnas rnams su bsgrub bya'i bris sku bkram/ mchod gtor/ rdor dril/ nang mchod/ mchod pa la sogs pa rnams nyer bsdogs bya/ stan bde bar khrus bya/ gos gsar pa gyon la shar du phyogs pas 'dug ste/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ nang mchod/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ kaṃ las byung ba'i mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang gi dbus su na las mi'i sha/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha| byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ de rnams kyi steng gi dbus su bum phyogs bzhir aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ slar yang dbus su buṃ las dri chu/ shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rak+ta/ nub byang du shu las byang sems/ byang shar du ma las klad pa de rnams kyi steng du māṃ lāṃ bāṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i mthar ā di kā dis bskor ba/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas khol nyes skyon thams cad lbu ba'i tshul du phyir lud/ rlangs pa 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pas rgyal ba 'khor bcas kyi byin rlabs brtan g.yo'i ro bcud thams cad bsdus nas yi ge la thim zhing*/ yi ge thams cad zla dkyil dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ rang gi mtheb srin sbyar bas blangs te myang*/ sngon gtor bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngon ltar byas nas/ thod pa'i rgyas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/

sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñja tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod rnams su hūm̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal| dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las byung ba'i mchod sprin lta bur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wi d+ye= shapad= zhes byin gyis brlabs/ srung 'khor ni/ sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad stong zhing 'od gsal ba'i ngang las/ 'og gi mthar thug cing rgya che bar rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang sa 'og gi steng gi bar du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i ra ba dang*/ steng du rdo rje mda'i dra ba dang*/ 'og tu rdo rje'i bla bres brgyan pa'i rdo rje'i gur te thams cad kyang sra zhing mkhregs la bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar zhing 'od zer 'khrugs pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad nyir 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa'i shar du gshin rje mthar byed/ lhor shes rab mthar byed/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed/ byang du bgegs mthar byed/ mer 'dod rgyal/ srin por dbyug sngon can/ rlung du stobs chen/ dbang ldan du mi g.yo ba/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor sgyur/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rnams zhal gsum phyag drug pa rang rang gi phyag mtshan rgyan chas yongs su rdzogs pa g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis rtsibs la ma reg tsam pa'i pad nyir gnas pa/

sku las ye shes kyi me 'od bskal me ltar 'bar ba rang gi sprul pa dpag tu med pas kyang khams gsum na gnas pa'i bgegs tshogs ma lus pa brlag par byed pa 'khor lo yang rgyun mi 'chad par g.yas bskor gyis drag tu 'khor zhing 'bar ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar dkyil 'khor pa'i tshul du spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud| |stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ */med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// ces 'dud nyi shu pas bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur thob shog gi bar du gsum bya/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ srung 'khor gyi lte bar chos 'byung dkar po nam mkha'i tshul can 'og phra zhing steng yangs pa la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing ga'i dbus su rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phro ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa snang la rang bzhin med par gyur/

'di yan ni sgrub thabs thams cad thun mong du'o// gsang 'dus 'jam rdor lha dgu ni/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su re'u mig rdo rjes mtshan pa dgu'i dbus dang shar dang grwa bzhir sna tshogs pad zla/ lho nub byang gsum sna tshogs pad nyi/ gdan dbus dmar rang nyid 'jam dpal rdo rje gur gum gyi mdog can ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi 'og ma bzhi ral gri mda' ut+pal gzhu/ shar du rnam snang dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal 'khor lo ral gri nor bu pad+ma/ lhor rin 'byung ser nag dkar ba'i zhal rin chen cha dgu ral gri 'khor lo pad+ma/ nub tu snang mtha' dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal pad+ma ral gri nor bu 'khor lo// byang du don grub ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal ral gri 'khor lo nor bu pad+ma/ lnga ka'ang phyag dang po gnyis rang snang gi yum rang 'dra la 'khyud pa/ mer spyan ma dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal 'khor lo ral gri nor bu pad+ma/ srin por mā ma kī sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal ut+pal ral gri nor bu pad+ma/ rlung du gos dkar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal pad+ma ral gri nor bu 'khor lo// dbang ldan du sgrol ma ser nag dmar ba'i zhal ut+pal ral gri nor bu pad+ma/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i cod pan dang rgyan du mas brgyan pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phro ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga mā ma kī rnams mi bskyod pa/ spyan ma rnam snang*/ gos dkar mo snang mtha'/ sgrol ma la don grub ste rgyas 'debs kyi lha rnams kyang rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par dmigs/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ bha ga wa te sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod thigs gtor bya zhing*/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

yi dam rgyal ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam pa ye shes chos skyong ba'i srung ma mkha' 'gro tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhi bdag 'gro drug gi sems can dkyil 'khor gyi lhar gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes gsang mchod/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes de kho nas mchod| bstod pa ni rdor dril dang bcas pas/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud| |sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud| |sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud| |thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// ces bstod/ bzlas pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang yum bzhi'i thugs kar rang rang gi phyag mtshan gyi lte bar buṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ māṃ lāṃ bā'aṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams kyis mtshan par dmigs nas/ gtso bo'i oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ rigs bzhi'i oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ rat+na dhṛka /ā ro lika /pradz+nyā dhṛka /yum bzhi'i/ mo ha ra ti/ dwe ṣa ra ti/ rā ga ra ti/ badz+ra ra ti/ zhes ci nus bzla'o// dgyes rdor thod pa can lha dgu ni/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar gan rkyal du gnas pa'i tshangs pa/

khyab 'jug /dbang phyug /lha dbang ste bdud bzhi/ 'dab ma phyogs bzhir tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang*/ drag po/ mtshams bzhir gshin rje/ lus ngan/ srin po/ thags bzang ris rnams kyi snying gar zla dkyil/ gdan dbus mar rang nyid dgyes pa rdo rje nag po gcer bu nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs bzhi mdun gnyis skyil krung phyed pa dang rgyab gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyi gar gyis gnas pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbu skra dmar ser 'bar ba/ thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse bran can skra mtshams su bcings pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rtsa zhal nag po g.yas dkar g.yon dmar lhag ma bzhi nag cing steng zhal dud kha mi sdug pa/ zhal thams cad smin ma 'khyog cing dmar zlum gyi spyan gsum gsum pa mche ba bzhi bzhi cung zad gtsigs pa'i khro gnyer can thod pa dang bcas pa'i phyag bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad glang chen rta bong bu glang rnga mong mi sha ra bha byi la/ g.yon brgyad sa chu me rlung zla nyi gshin rje nor sbyin rnams thogs pa'i phyag dang po gnyis yum la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa'i pang du yum bdag med ma nag mo gcer bu gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud cing g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ 'dab ma shar du gau rī nag mo gri gug dang nya ro hi ta/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo ḍā ru dang phag |nub tu ro langs ma gser mdog rus sbal dang pad+ma/ byang du ghasma rī ljang khu sbrul dang thod pa/ shar lhor puk+ka sī sngon mo seng ge dang dgra sta/ lho nub tu sha wa rī dkar mo dge slong dang gsil byed/ nub byang du tsaṇ+ḍa lī sngo sangs 'khor lo dang thong gshol/ byang shar du ḍoṃ bhi nī khra mo rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub/ brgyad ka'ang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can lha mo dgu zhal gcig spyan gsum mche gtsigs skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag rgya lngas spras shing thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can rkang gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa/

gtso bo yab yum mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas lnga/ gau rī puk+ka sī mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī sha wa rī rnam snang*/ ro langs ma tsaṇ+ḍa lī rin 'byung*/ ghasma rī ḍoṃ bhi nī snang mtha' cod pan can ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par dmigs/ mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ bzlas pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐ bsam zhing*/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// bde mchog lha lnga ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba nyi ma'i steng du 'jigs dus/ phyogs bzhir dbugs bral gyi gdan dang bcas pa gdan dbus dmar rang nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog nag po mdun nas g.yon skor du nag ljang dmar ser gyi zhabs bzhi spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis rdor dril bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og gnyis glang chen dkar po'i pags pa khrag bcas brgyangs pa/ lhag ma g.yas bzhi ḍā ru/ dgra sta/ gri gug /rtse gsum/ g.yon bzhi rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ/ thod khrag |rdor zhags/ tshangs mgo/ ral pa'i thor cog gi rtse mor nor bu/ mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pas spras pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod skam lnga dang thon rlon khrag bcas lnga bcu'i do shal can/ mi'i rgyus pa'i tshangs skud dang phyag rgya drug gis spras pa/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing g.yas brkyang gis bzhengs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis skra grol ba gcer mo thod dum gyi ska rags can/ g.yas sdigs mdzub kyis rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag bcas yab la 'khyud pa thod skam gyi phreng ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor can phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing cung zad bzhad pa zla mtshan 'bab pa dang bcas la ba spu gyen du langs pa zhabs gnyis yab la 'khyud pa/

'dab ma shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig spyan gsum skra grol ba phyag bzhi'i g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ dang thod khrag /g.yas ḍā ru gri gug g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa/ mtshams bzhir byang sems khrag gi bdud rtsi lnga sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa dang bum pa gnas pa/ gtso bo mi bskyod pa yab yum rnam snang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi rin 'byung gi cod pan can ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par dmigs/ sngar ltar mchod cing bstod/ bzlas pa ni| gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐ dmigs/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ zhes dung chen gyi phreng ba bzung nas bzla'o// dus 'khor lha dgu ni/ gzhal yas khang gi lte bar pad+ma ljang gu 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla nyi sgra gcan dus me 'dod lha drag po'i gdan la rang nyid dus kyi 'khor lo nag po g.yas brkyang gis gar byed pa/ nor bu zla phyed sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can rdo rje nor bu'i mgul rgyan gdub skor ska rags can rkang gdub dar dpyangs phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can rtsa zhal nag po drag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags bcas/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po zhi ba spyan bcu gnyis pa/ dbus sngo/ g.yon dmar/ g.yas dkar ba'i mgrin pa g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po gnyis sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ de dag las gyes pa'i dpung pa drug drug /phyag g.yas dang g.yon gyi dang po bzhi bzhi nag po/ gnyis pa bzhi bzhi dmar po/ gsum pa bzhi bzhi dkar po/ phyag zhabs thams cad kyi mthe bong nas mthe'u chung gi bar ser dkar dmar nag ljang ba/ sor mo rnams kyi tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/

thams cad kyang sor gdub kyis mdzes shing 'od 'phro ba/ g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhi rdo rje/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri gug /dmar po bzhi me'i mda'/ lcags kyu/ ḍā ru/ tho ba/ dkar po bzhi 'khor lo/ mdung*/ dbyug pa/ dgra sta/ g.yon gyi nag po bzhi dril bu/ phub/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ thod khrag /dmar po bzhi gzhu/ zhags pa/ nor bu/ pad dkar/ dkar po bzhi dung*/ me long*/ lcags sgrog /tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas dmar po/ g.yon pa dkar po/ 'dod lha dang drag po'i gzhogs su dga' ma dang dkar mo gnyis gdong smad pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 'jus pa/ bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum gser mdog g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ mdun nas g.yas skor gyi ser dkar sngo dmar gyi zhal bzhi phyag brgyad g.yas gri gug /lcags kyu/ ḍā ru/ bgrang phreng*/ g.yon thod pa/ zhags pa/ pad dkar/ rin chen/ pad 'dab shar dang shar lhor nag mo 'bar ma dang du ba ma nag dmar ser dkar gyi zhal bzhi phyag brgyad/ g.yas spos tsan+dan gur gum ga pur gla rtsi sbyar ba'i snod/ g.yon dril bu pad+ma lha'i shing gi me tog sna tshogs pa'i phreng ba dang*/ rnga yab nag po brgyad/ lho dang lho nub tu dmar mo 'bar ma dang smig sgyu ma dmar ser dkar sngo'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad/ g.yas dmar mo do shal/ cod pan/ lag gdub/ g.yon gos/ ska rags/ sna rgyan/ rkang gdub dang ska rags/ rnga yab dmar po brgyad/ byang dang byang shar du dkar mo 'bar ma dang mkha' nang ma dkar nag dmar ser gyi zhal bzhi phyag brgyad/ g.yas 'o ma chu lha'i sman chang rnams kyi snod/ g.yon bdud rtsi grub pa'i bcud bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu bza' ba rnams kyi snod dang*/ rnga yab dkar po brgyad/ nub dang nub byang du ser mo 'bar ma dang mar me ma ser dkar sngo dmar gyi zhal bzhi phyag brgyad/ g.yas dung*/ gling bu/ nor bu/ ḍā ru/ g.yon pi wang*/ rnga zlum/ 'khar rnga/ zangs dung dang*/ rnga yab ser po brgyad/ lha mo dgu ka spyan gsum phyag rgya lnga ldan/

phyogs mtshams kyi lha mo brgyad ni zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa/ gtso bo ral pa'i cod pan dang lha mo rnams rin po che'i cod pan can yab la mi bskyod pa dang lha mo brgyad rdor sems kyis rgyas gdab pa ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ bzlas pa ni gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐ dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥham̐k+ṣ+malawaraya swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// phag mo lha lnga ni/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar ro'i gdan la rang nyid rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ ral pa grol zhing rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po thur du bsgrad pa thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsgrengs pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi rting pa bha ga la gtad cing g.yon brkyang ba/ 'dab ma shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams sngo ser dmar ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche gtsigs skra grol ba/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can phyag rgya lngas spras pa brkyang bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo la snam snang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhir rang rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pas rgyas btab pa ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ sngar ltar mchod bstod| bzlas pa ni/ gtso mo'i thugs kar baṃ bsam/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ci nus bzlas so// 'jigs byed yum bcas lha dgu ni/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar pad+ma zla nyi'i gdan la rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong pa can char sprin gyi mdog lta bu/

steng zhal srin po'i zhal dmar po khrag 'dzag pa'i steng du 'jam dpal rdo rje'i zhal ser po yid tsam khros pa/ rwa'i rtsa ba'i g.yas kyi zhal gsum sngo dmar dkar ba/ g.yon gyi zhal gsum dkar dud ljang ba spyan gsum gsum ral pa thams cad bsdus pa 'jam dpal rdo rje'i dbu'i steng na thor cog byas pa/ phyag so bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis gri thod 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis glang lpags brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag ma bco lnga mtshon rtse gcig /gtun shing*/ chu gri/ rtse gcig pa/ sta re/ mdung thung*/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ dbyug tho/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ tho ba/ ral gri/ cang te'u/ g.yon bco snga tshangs mgo/ phub/ rkang pa/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ rgyu ma/ dril bu/ lag pa/ dur ras/ gsal shing la bskyon pa'i ro/ me thab/ thod tshal/ sdigs mdzub/ 'phan/ rtse gsum rlung ras 'dzin pa/ zhabs bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad bskum pas/ mi/ ma he/ glang*/ bong bu/ rnga mo/ khyi| lug /wa/ g.yon brgyad brkyang bas/ bya rgod/ 'ug pa/ bya rog /ne tso/ khra/ khyung*/ kaṃ ka /bzhad rnams mnan pa/ g.yas pa'i byol song brgyad kyis brgya byin dang tshangs pa/ g.yon pa'i 'dab chags brgyad kyis dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug mnan pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ yab yum dur khrod kyi chas brgyad sbrul stag gis brgyan pa/ rtsibs shar du gshin rje chos rgyal nag po dbyug tho/ rgyu zhags/ yum mgo dgu rkang gcig ma yab lta bus 'khyud pa/ shar lhor gdol pa nag po dbyug tho/ thod khrag |yum khro mo phag mgo ma rang 'dra/ lhor a wa glang mgo dud kha lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ yum gshin rje kha rgyal ma rang 'dra/ lho nub tu ya ba ti nag po ral gri/ zhags pa/ yum nag mo chen mo shel mig ma rang 'dra/ nub tu gshin rje mig dmar dmar po ral gri/ thod pa/ yum lag brgya ma rang 'dra/ nub byang du phya sangs dkar nag tri shū la/ zhags pa/ yum a shol ma rang 'dra/

byang du dmigs pa ljang nag thod dbyug /zhags pa/ yum nag mo chen mo rang 'dra/ byang shar du ral pa tshar dgu nag po thod dbyug /zhags pa/ yum ma mo nag mo rang 'dras 'khyud pa/ thams cad dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa gtso bo yab yum mi bskyod pa 'khor rnams don grub kyi cod pan can ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par dmigs/ mchod bstod sngar ltar bya/ bzlas pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐ nag po bsam/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla'o// gshed dmar lha lnga ni/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i mtshams sna tshogs rdo rjes gtams pa'i lte bar pad+mar ma he glang rgod kyi steng du rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhal gcig spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas khams gsum 'joms pa'i dbyug tho/ g.yon bdud khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ljags 'dril sha rgyas stag sham can glang po'i ko rlon gsol ba/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i pang du yum rdo rje ro langs ma gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ rtsibs shar du gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu| yum tsartsi ka dkar mo gri thod/ lhor ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ser po rin po che'i dril bu/ yum phag mo ser mo gri thod/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po pad+ma dril bu| yum dbyangs can ma dmar mo gri thod/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang gu rgya gram dril bu/ yum gau rī ljang mo gri thod 'dzin pa yum rnams yab la 'khyud pa/ yab yum thams cad dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa gtso bo la rgyal ba lnga dang*/ gshin rje bzhi rang rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i cod pan can ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pa bsam| mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ bzlas pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐ dmar po bsam/

oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bzla'o// de ltar bla med kyi sgrub thabs bdun po gang byed kyang*/ thun mthar rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rim gyis bsdus pa gzhal yas khang la thim/ de 'khor la/ 'khor rnams gtso bo yab yum phag mo yin na 'khor rnams gtso mo la de thugs ka'i sa bon la/ la thim/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i sa bon la/ de yang mi dmigs par gyur par bsam/ thun mtshams rnams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma zar sgong lta bu pad+mas bskor ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma zlum po pad+mas bskor ba bshams/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'das gtor 'bul ba ni/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ phaiṃ/ snying ga'i 'od kyis gtor mgron dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs spyan drangs/ pad kor bya zhing*/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ gsum dang*/ lag pa g.yon par ā di las zla ba dang*/ g.yas par kā di las nyi ma dang dbus su hūm̐ sngon po dang bcas pa/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tā sarba dharmaḥpa ram+ba ra a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sarba dharmaḥ.a d+yan+ta a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sarba dharma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zla nyi sa bon yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje thal mos gtor ma bteg par mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i 'od kyi rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ā' ra li hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes gsum gyis 'bul zhing chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// sogs 'dud nyi shu pas bstod/ 'jig rten par/ pheṃ/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis 'jig rten pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sogs sngags tshar gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod bstod/ yig brgya bzla/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/

ye shes pa rnams rang nyid la thim par bsam/ tshogs 'khor ni/ tshogs rdzas 'du byas la nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshogs phud gtor mar sgron zhing*/ hūm̐ chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing khams nas// yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// ma sring mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro'i tshogs// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren na// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs nas kyang*// thabs kyi bza' ba sna tshogs dang*| |shes rab ma da na la sogs// 'dod yon dam rdzas rmad byung rnams// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes su gsol// bdag cag mched lcam 'khor bcas kyi// phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang*| |thun mchog dngos grub kun thob nas// bde ba'i sa ru phyin par shog /ces dbul/ tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus par/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣa bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes phyir 'bul/ gzhan yang nyal ba dang*/ ldang ba dang*/ khrus dang*/ kha zas la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnams ni sgrub thabs gzhan ltar yang bya'o// de ltar gsang ba bla med rgyud sde rgya mtsho las grags che zhing nye bar mkho ba'i sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig blo dman rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir mdor bsdus te smras pa'ang*/ 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung las rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas bris pa 'dis kyang rang dang skal ba mnyam pa rnams la smin par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu//
